page.layout: One page of running text in one column, with a closing word "FINIS" centred below it. No margin notes, running head, catchword or signature.

main_text.p: retur, futurum esse vt Deus bonum eum usum non destitueret, pertinet ad eius unam misericordiam deprædicandam, cuius laus est infinita.

Quia autem œconomia illa Naturæ atque Prouidentiæ, neque spiritum suppeditat, qui facultatem recte comparet, neque si suppeditaret usitata atque ordinaria copia, rem tantam præstare posset vt ex mentibus hominum caliginem errorum atque idolatriæ depelleret, neque si eam depelleret, lucem tamen eam subministraret, quæ temporibus ijs conuenit, quibus Christus exhibitus est; & omni tempore Dei verbum necessarium fuit, & nunc verbum Euangelij absolute necessarium esse AMYRALDVS constanter iudicauit. Cuius sui iudicij causas explicauit & confirmauit. Con. III. de Natura Euangelij, & Defens. Caluini cap. 12. & 13[?].

page.notes: The first word "retur" is a fragment carried over from the previous page. The printed "13" is followed by a mark that may be a semicolon or full stop. Some letters in the running text are worn, but all lines are legible. The word "Prouidentiæ" is printed with a v, and I kept it.
